title: PBA: Ginebra clobbers Phoenix to fuel quarterfinal bid
summary: Barangay Ginebra breathed life into its quarterfinal bid in the 2026 PBA Governors' Cup on Sunday, clobbering Phoenix Super LPG 106-89 at the Ynares Center in Antipolo.
